t: What is BTST (Buy Today, Sell Tomorrow) in Indian stock markets
s: September 27, 2025 - BTST stands for Buy Today, Sell Tomorrow. The Indian capital markets follow a T+1 settlement cycle. For instance, if a stock is purchased on Monday, it is delivered to the demat account on Tuesday.
